description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by sacrificing it.
When Sakura-Tribe Elder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Sakura-Tribe Elder ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
